name: Delta Air Lines
species: Small dogs, cats and household birds (birds only within the contiguous U.S.)
max_carrier_dimensions: Depends on aircraft under-seat space; Delta recommends a soft-sided kennel of max 18 x 11 x 11 in, which fits most aircraft

fees.amount: $150 USD/CAD each way (tickets issued on/after Apr 8, 2025; $95 before)
$200 USD each way (tickets issued on/after Apr 8, 2025; $75 before)

checked_or_cargo: No checked pets for the general public. Delta Cargo ships pets only for active U.S. Military or U.S. State Department Foreign Service personnel with permanent change of station orders (until further notice).
banned_breeds: Brachycephalic (snub-nosed) dogs, cats and their mixes are not permitted in cargo (per Delta's Shipping Your Pet page).
banned_routes: No in-cabin pets to/from Australia, Barbados, Brazil/Colombia/Dominican Republic (originating), Hawaii (flights to), Hong Kong, Iceland, Jamaica, New Zealand, South Africa, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates. No pets in Delta One, Delta Premium or international Business.
service_animal_note: Trained service animals follow separate guidelines (see Delta's service animal page).

recent_changes.summary: In-cabin pet fee for U.S./Canada/PR/USVI rose from $95 to $150 each way for tickets issued on/after April 8, 2025.
Dogs entering Mexico need a New World Screwworm Inspection Certificate issued no more than 5 days before arrival, verified at check-in.

notes: A reported October 2026 change to Delta's carry-on pet policy could not be confirmed on Delta's official pages on 2026-10-22; values above reflect the official page as fetched.
